environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in a private subnet (subnet-0x7f3a2e) within VPC vpc-0a9b8c7d. The subnet route table (rtb-04e5f6a7) contains only a local route (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) and no NAT gateway, NAT instance, or VPC endpoint routes for any AWS service. The only ingress path is via internal ALB (scheme=internal) on port 8080. Security group sg-0abc123def permits inbound TCP/8080 from sg-0fed321cba (ALB SG) only, and permits NO outbound rules except to the VPC CIDR on ephemeral ports for ALB health checks. The task IAM role has an explicit Deny on all S3, SSM, and Secrets Manager actions via a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::222222222222:policy/NoExternalAccess). DNS resolution within the VPC has no Route53 resolver outbound endpoints configured.

network.subnet: private, no IGW route, no NAT gateway, no NAT instance

iam.permissions_boundary: Explicit Deny on s3:*, ssm:*, secretsmanager:*, lambda:Invoke*

config.container: non-root user (uid 1000), read-only root filesystem with tmpfs on /var/app/uploads and /var/app/data (noexec mount option)
